verdict.rationale: The only native recurring mechanism in the evidence is Hummingbird's automatic re-review: it creates a pending case review that reopens on a cadence (typically 90 days). That is a narrow, case-specific recurring trigger, not a general job or workflow scheduler, and the 'customizable automation' and 'ongoing monitoring' marketing language never mentions schedules. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules for arbitrary jobs or workflows, documented cron/interval configuration, API or agent-accessible scheduling, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Hummingbird creates a "pending" review of the case that will automatically open when it's time to review the case again (typically 90 days).
Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
